reset.rng_call_order: for every candidate: x uniform, y uniform, optional ylim_prop y uniform, fixed-z uniform
reset.assignment: sort accepted candidates by ascending y, then name bowl1, bowl2, bowl3

mantis_base.adaptation_rule: retain source world x, z, and yaw; translate the fixed Mantis pelvis +0.10 m along world y to cover the frozen source reset workspace

adaptation_evidence.claim_boundary: diagnostic IK coverage only; no trajectory, contact, or task-success claim

tcp.orientation_semantics: local +x approaches world +y; jaw separation is approximately world x

contact_probe.friction_semantics: Genesis 1.2.3 pair coefficient is the maximum of the two geom coefficients
contact_probe.orientation_semantics: local +x points world -z for top-down insertion; local +y jaw axis follows world +y across the near rim
contact_probe.staged_orientation_semantics: 60 degree transit at z 0.90 m, 80 degree pregrasp at z 0.875 m, then 90 degree rim insertion at z 0.84 m
contact_probe.lift_orientation_semantics: 60 degree world-y pitch preserves the radial jaw axis while entering the verified upper workspace
contact_probe.grasp_offset_derivation: near rim center uses the measured bowl collision radius 0.0678 m; TCP z 0.84 m puts the 0.0652 m clamp tip about 17 mm below the 0.792 m rim top

consecutive_left_inter_bowl_transition.activation: previous assigned side is left, current assigned side is left, and current stack level is at least 2
consecutive_left_inter_bowl_transition.route: vertical at the prior retreat XY using grasp orientation; reorient at clearance; lateral at clearance using transit orientation; descend to the unchanged front-clearance pose
consecutive_left_inter_bowl_transition.claim_boundary: scripted consecutive-left transition only; not a task-success, learned-policy, AMD/ROCm, hardware, or real-robot claim

contact_probe.gripper_tracking_scope: contact-free open navigation stages only; blocked closure against the bowl is expected
contact_probe.claim_boundary: single-bowl contact smoke only; not a complete episode or G1

bimanual_contact_probe.friction_semantics: Genesis 1.2.3 pair coefficient is the maximum of the two geom coefficients
bimanual_contact_probe.orientation_semantics: closed grippers act as opposed pads; each wrist local +x points inward and 10 degrees downward so the clamp tips can support the bowl below its rim
bimanual_contact_probe.slide_orientation_semantics: horizontal opposed pads push near the bowl sidewall without the downward pitch used only by the lift diagnostic
bimanual_contact_probe.geometry_derivation: grasp half-span 0.120 m equals bowl radius 0.0678 m plus clamp forward extent 0.0652 m minus 0.013 m squeeze; v6 retained bilateral clamp contact but measured about 0.008 m total TCP opening under load
bimanual_contact_probe.gripper_tracking_scope: closed grippers remain position-controlled throughout; contact force comes from symmetric arm approach
bimanual_contact_probe.claim_boundary: bimanual single-bowl contact smoke only; not a complete episode or G1

bimanual_rim_hook_probe.friction_semantics: Genesis 1.2.3 pair coefficient is the maximum of the two geom coefficients
bimanual_rim_hook_probe.orientation_semantics: each wrist local +x points horizontally inward; the left local +y points world +y and 35 degrees downward while the right local +y mirrors it toward world -y and 35 degrees downward, selecting the corresponding hook finger on both arms
bimanual_rim_hook_probe.geometry_derivation: the local timing sweep measured 9.675 mm at 0.24 s, 9.761 mm at 0.25 s, and 8.003 mm at 0.26 s; v21 freezes the validated local optimum at 20 mm over 0.25 s with the v4 horizontal shelf, constant 0.115 m half-span, 0.65 lift opening, and unchanged force limits
bimanual_rim_hook_probe.gripper_tracking_scope: contact-free open navigation stages only; blocked symmetric closure against the rim is expected
bimanual_rim_hook_probe.claim_boundary: bimanual rim-hook single-bowl contact smoke only; not a complete episode or G1
